equation: partial_t u - Delta u + (u dot nabla)u + nabla p = 0, div u = 0 on R^3 x (-infinity,0), viscosity 1
lemma: A bounded ancient mild solution in the KNSS sense that converges to zero in D'(R^3) as t approaches 0 from below is identically zero.

status_vocabulary.SOURCE: stated in the cited primary source
status_vocabulary.SOURCE_PLUS_SCALING: source estimate restarted on a uniform parabolic interval and rescaled algebraically
status_vocabulary.DERIVATION: laboratory implication, not attributed to a paper
status_vocabulary.CROSSCHECK: second proof route not needed by the selected direct route

properties.unforced_viscous_ns: standard unforced incompressible Navier-Stokes with positive viscosity
properties.ancient_interval: one solution is defined for all negative times
properties.global_velocity_bound: sup over R^3 x (-infinity,0) of |u| is finite
properties.knss_mild_formula: the Oseen/Leray Duhamel formula restarts between every two finite negative times
properties.true_terminal_Dprime_zero: u(t) tends to zero in distributions as t approaches 0 from below
properties.same_object_trace: the terminal limit belongs to the same solution, not to a sequence of unrelated solutions
properties.bounded_vorticity_on_finite_strips: curl u is bounded on each finite strip, with a bound uniform up to t=0

O1_ANCIENT_MILD_RESTART.source: KNSS 2009, definition before Lemma 6.1 and the semigroup property
O1_ANCIENT_MILD_RESTART.conclusion: the mild formula may be restarted at every s<t<0

O2_UNIFORM_DERIVATIVES.conclusion: if M=sup|u|, then ||nabla^k partial_t^l u||_infinity <= C_(k,l) M^(k+2l+1), uniformly for t<0

O3_DPRIME_TO_SMOOTH_LOCAL_TRACE.source: uniform derivative bounds, Arzela-Ascoli and uniqueness of distributional limits; k=0,l=1 also yields a global L-infinity trace
O3_DPRIME_TO_SMOOTH_LOCAL_TRACE.conclusion: u tends to zero in C^m_local for every m, and in particular curl u has pointwise terminal trace zero

O4_ENDPOINT_MILD_EXTENSION.source: Oseen kernel L1 bound ||K(t)||_1 <= C t^(-1/2)
O4_ENDPOINT_MILD_EXTENSION.conclusion: for every a<0, u extended by u(0)=0 is a bounded mild solution on [a,0], as required only by the Lei-Yang-Yuan cross-check route

O5_BOUNDED_VORTICITY.conclusion: curl u is bounded uniformly up to the terminal time

O6_VORTICITY_INEQUALITY.source: curl of Navier-Stokes and the bounds from O2
O6_VORTICITY_INEQUALITY.conclusion: after time reversal, |partial_tau omega+Delta omega| <= C_M(|omega|+|nabla omega|)

O7_ESS_BACKWARD_UNIQUENESS.source: ESS 2003, Theorem 5.1 in the L3-infinity paper and the original parabolic backward-uniqueness theorem
O7_ESS_BACKWARD_UNIQUENESS.conclusion: the vorticity vanishes on every finite strip by application on translated half-spaces

O8_HARMONIC_CLASSIFICATION.source: Delta u = nabla div u - curl curl u and the bounded harmonic Liouville theorem

O9_MILD_CONSTANT_RIGIDITY.conclusion: a bounded ancient mild solution of the form b(t) is constant, and the trace makes it zero

O10_ALL_FINITE_STRIPS.source: apply O7 on every finite strip

O11_LEI_YANG_YUAN_ROUTE.conclusion: after O4, published final-state uniqueness gives a second velocity-level route; three arXiv-v1 anomalies require comparison with the publisher version before formalization

ACCELERATED_SPATIAL_CONSTANT.description: u=b(t), p=-b'(t) dot x, with bounded nonconstant b(t) tending to zero

NONZERO_CONSTANT_WITH_ASSIGNED_ENDPOINT.description: u=c for t<0, while the value u(0)=0 is assigned without being a limit

HIGH_FREQUENCY_DIVERGENCE_FREE_SLICES.description: f_N=(0,sin(N x_1),0) tends to zero in distributions but has ||nabla f_N||_infinity=N and is not one ancient trajectory

TRANSLATED_DIVERGENCE_FREE_PACKETS.description: a fixed smooth compact divergence-free packet translated to spatial infinity has a zero D' limit but no global L-infinity decay and is not one mild trajectory

KNSS_MAXIMUM_ZOOM_LIMIT.description: the maximum-normalized bounded ancient mild limit has |u(0,0)|=1
